newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 90,750 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 44.940 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in France received 31,000 tonnes, in the U.K. 23,000, in Germany 21,000, in Belgium 12,500, in Denmark 3,000 and in Spain 250 tonnes, it added.
Earlier on Wednesday, London traders had expected the subsidy for the current season whites campaign to be 44.940 Ecus per 100 kilos, the exact amount awarded.
Traders had also forecast the total authorised sugar tonnage export awards to be between 40,000 and 90,000 tonnes versus 97,750 last week when the restitution was 45.064 Ecus.
